high_priority.improvement: Evaluate additional labeled OOS training data in a separate experiment
high_priority.rationale: Observed false accepts motivate testing broader OOS coverage; document any new data protocol and retain the current official benchmark for comparability.
Domain-based taxonomy tags are heuristics. Inspect examples before drawing semantic conclusions; preserve official benchmark labels in the current comparison.

high_priority.improvement: Select OOS or abstention thresholds on validation data
high_priority.rationale: Specify a target trade-off on validation data and evaluate the fixed threshold on held-out data. Test ROC operating points alone do not establish deployment behavior.

high_priority.improvement: Evaluate temperature scaling for post-hoc calibration improvement
high_priority.rationale: Fit temperature scaling on validation data, then compare held-out calibration. Representative-run ECE differences alone do not establish its benefit across seeds.

medium_priority.improvement: Use fresh seeded loaders for each tuning trial
medium_priority.rationale: Make comparisons independent of advancing loader state and smoke-check shuffles. Changing this search policy requires new tuning and final evaluations.
Packed sequences or length-aware summaries could avoid processing right-PAD positions. This modeling change requires new training, tuning and comparisons.
Test their effect on the neural pipelines through new training and tuning rather than assuming improved generalization.
Use a specified device, warmup and repeated single-query measurements before making service-latency claims from batch throughput.

lower_priority.rationale: Add a separately trained and tuned reference with its own preprocessing and compute budget.
Validate whether findings generalize beyond CLINC150.

lower_priority.improvement: Subword tokenization (BPE, WordPiece) for better OOV handling
lower_priority.rationale: Reduce OOV rates and improve generalization to unseen vocabulary.

lower_priority.improvement: Evaluate a conventional in-scope-only MSP baseline
lower_priority.rationale: Train a separate classifier without the supervised OOS class; its uncertainty score answers a different question from the current 151-class MSP diagnostic.

lower_priority.improvement: Expand independently seeded runs and design uncertainty estimates
lower_priority.rationale: Distinguish test-example sampling uncertainty from training-run variation; three seeds and overlapping mean/std ranges alone do not justify significance claims.
